name: Sam
look: Sam, age 41, slim build with narrow shoulders and a lean neck (not muscular); oval face, straight brows, blue-grey eyes, slightly upturned nose, small closed-mouth smile, clean-shaven, fair skin with a warm undertone; short medium-brown hair, short at the sides with a textured 4-5 cm top falling slightly forward and a few grey strands at the temples (never swept back or a pompadour); plain charcoal crewneck knit sweater, slim dark trousers, white running sneakers

rows.label: stance, crouch and guard
poses: fighting stance: relaxed and understated, side-on, weight on the balls of the feet, loose fists at chest height
dropping into a crouch, knees half bent
full crouch, low on bent knees, hands up guarding
standing block: forearms raised in front of the face, chin tucked
crouching block: low crouch with forearms crossed in front of the face

rows.label: jump

falling: legs extending down to land
landing: knees absorbing the impact, low

fist retracting to guard

rear fist cocked high behind the ear
looping overhand right coming over the top

recovering to guard

front knee lifting

foot returning

rows.label: heavy kick: turning kick

leg sweeping through
returning to stance
